name: default
description: General health: ingredient simplicity and avoiding added sugar/oil matter most. Calories are not weighted. NOTE: these 5 weights are relative - compute_score() renormalizes over whichever sub-scores actually apply, so they need not sum to 1.0. The organic bonus is weighted from category_facts.json instead of here, since it's a fact about the food category, not a health-philosophy choice. external_processing was lowered 0.17 -> 0.12 on 2026-09-15: NOVA is a genuinely useful outside opinion but it is a third-party summary, and at 0.17 it was the second-heaviest sub-score in the whole profile, outweighed only by our own flagged-ingredient analysis.
